verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is a law firm, but it does offer client-facing legal-tech tools, so a bulk-operations axis is a fair question here. The evidence never shows a user-driven bulk or batch capability. The SCC and Term Sheet generators produce one document at a time through an interactive questionnaire. Evaluate and the Luminance-assisted review are only vaguely described as automated or AI-assisted review, not as bulk operations a user can run. Probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec that could enable programmatic bulk actions.
